page.overview:
Who is Zach Mitchell?

Zachary "Zach" Mitchell is a teenage boy who was present in the incident at Jurassic World, with his younger brother, Gray. He is the older son of Karen and Scott, as well as the older nephew of Claire Dearing.

Zach appears in the novel, The Evolution of Claire, as a toddler. He plays no major role in the book.

Zach was talking to his girlfriend about how he should send texts so that she doesn't "forget" him. After that, he entered into the car with his and Gray's mother and father, preparing to go to a local airport to go to Jurassic World.

After boarding an airplane, Gray and Zach boarded a ferry boat to Masrani Global Corporation's famous dinosaur theme park Jurassic World, whose aunt, Claire Dearing, was Senior Assets Manager for. They were supervised by Claire's personal assistant Zara, as Claire was too busy to spend time with her nephews. While there, they got to see many of Jurassic World's attractions, including the Mosasaurus Feeding Show, Underwater Observatory, and the T. rex Kingdom, with Zach showing some interest in the former event. On the way, in the Monorail, Zach told his brother to stop crying and grow up, seeing as how Gray was in tears after hearing that their parents are getting divorced.
